short: A payment QR that already carries the exact bill amount.
seoTitle: Dynamic QR Code — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A dynamic QR code encodes the specific amount and reference for one transaction, so the customer scans and confirms without typing anything.
definition: A dynamic QR code encodes the specific amount and reference for one transaction, so the customer scans and confirms without typing anything. Each bill gets its own code.
bodyHtml:
Why Dynamic QR Code matters

Typed amounts are where payment errors live — a missing zero, a wrong bill matched to a payment. A dynamic code removes both, and speeds up the queue at the same time.

How Dynamic QR Code works in practice

Generate the code from the bill at the moment of payment and include a reference so the credit can be matched back automatically. It is the standard for counters, table-side payment and delivery.

faq.question: What is the difference between a dynamic and a static QR?
faq.answer: A dynamic code carries the amount and reference for one bill; a static code is a fixed display where the customer types the amount.

faq.question: Do I need special hardware?
faq.answer: No. A dynamic code can be shown on the billing screen or printed on the receipt.
